page_title: MAR 1-1 LIL | Marseille v Lille 14/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Referee Willy Delajod halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Roberto De Zerbi, then shows him a yellow.
90+5' Pol Lirola (Marseille) makes an ugly challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
90+2' What was Andre Gomes (Lille) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
90+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Benjamin Andre (Lille) was quite harsh and Willy Delajod didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
90' Luis Henrique (Marseille) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
90' The referee blows his whistle as Alexsandro (Lille) was too aggressive in his challenge. Marseille have a free kick.
88' A substitution has been made. Neal Maupay goes off and Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) comes on.

87' 1 - 1 The ball from the free kick finds its way to Bafode Diakite (Lille) who finds himself some space and scores with a thunderous header into the top right corner. An incredible long-range header!
86' Willy Delajod shows a yellow card to Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) for his blatant foul.
84' Roberto De Zerbi decides to make a substitution. Mason Greenwood will be replaced by Bilal Nadir (Marseille).

83' Jonathan David (Lille) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Geronimo Rulli. This effort really didn't trouble him.
81' The referee signals a substitution. Remy Cabella (Lille) is brought on as a substitute for Hakon Arnar Haraldsson.
81' Looks like Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
79' Lille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
77' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) picks up the rebound just outside the box and releases a weak low shot that heads towards the right post, but it fails to give the goalkeeper anything to worry about.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Quentin Merlin leaves the pitch and Pol Lirola (Marseille) comes on.
74' Roberto De Zerbi prepares a substitution. Valentin Rongier is replaced by Derek Cornelius (Marseille).
74' Geronimo Rulli makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Osame Sahraoui (Lille) after a cross from the side.
72' Mitchel Bakker (Lille) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
70' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) takes the corner but it's cleared.
69' Luis Henrique (Marseille) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Marseille force their opponents to concede a corner.
68' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
67' Osame Sahraoui (Lille) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
65' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Ngalayel Mukau as he is replaced by Andre Gomes (Lille).
65' Bruno Genesio has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Osame Sahraoui (Lille) replacing Mathias Fernandez-Pardo.
65' Substitution. Thomas Meunier (Lille) on for Aissa Mandi.
63' Bafode Diakite (Lille) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
62' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul.
60' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

60' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lille.
60' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is out of play. Lille will have a throw-in.
58' The corner from Mason Greenwood (Marseille) is intercepted by the defence.

58' The ball goes out of play. Marseille are awarded a corner kick. Lucas Chevalier pulls off a fantastic save! Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the top of the net, but the effort is kept out.
57' Marseille take a short corner kick.
57' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort. Marseille have a corner.
55' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
53' Jonathan David (Lille) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the bottom left corner. Geronimo Rulli is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
52' Mitchel Bakker (Lille) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
51' Marseille seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
48' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
48' Lille showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession. The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.
46' Bruno Genesio makes a half-time substitution. Mitchel Bakker (Lille) comes on in place of Edon Zhegrova.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Geronimo Rulli (Marseille) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
43' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
41' Luis Henrique (Marseille) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
38' Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) commits a rough challenge and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for an infringement.

37' Lille slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.

35' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.
33' Marseille are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

31' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the left post. Terrific solo effort, though. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
30' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Willy Delajod no option but to blow his whistle.
29' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
28' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
27' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lille, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Lille force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
27' Luis Henrique (Marseille) was too forceful with his tackle and Willy Delajod interrupted the game to signal a free kick. There is a free kick near the sideline to Lille.
26' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

26' Jonathan David (Lille) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. Geronimo Rulli guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. The ball goes out of play. Lille are awarded a corner kick.
24' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.
23' Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
20' Wonderful movement by Lille. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
17' 1 - 0 Quentin Merlin (Marseille) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Lucas Chevalier with a strike into the top left corner. He makes it 1:0.

16' Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Willy Delajod with no other option than to blow for a foul.
14' Marseille are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
11' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
10' Willy Delajod has a clear sight and sees a foul from Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille).

10' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Marseille are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
8' Lille take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
8' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. Now Lille have a corner.

6' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
5' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. It will be a corner kick for Lille.
4' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
3' Bafode Diakite (Lille) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong. The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Lille will take the kick-off.
Willy Delajod is the one to supervise the game today.
